request.question: How does AliasGenerator help use different naming conventions when loading and saving?

`AliasGenerator` is a class that allows you to specify multiple alias generators for a model. You can use an `AliasGenerator` to specify different alias generators for validation and serialization. This is particularly useful if you need to use different naming conventions for loading and saving data, but you don't want to specify the validation and serialization aliases for each field individually. For example: ```py from pydantic import AliasGenerator, BaseModel, ConfigDict class Tree(BaseModel): model_config = ConfigDict( alias_generator=AliasGenerator( validation_alias=lambda field_name: field_name.upper(), serialization_alias=lambda field_name: field_name.title(), ) ) age: int height: float kind: str t = Tree.model_validate({'AGE': 12, 'HEIGHT': 1.2, 'KIND': 'oak'}) print(t.model_dump(by_alias=True)) #> {'Age': 12, 'Height': 1.2, 'Kind': 'oak'} ```", "version_binding": "unversioned", "content_sha256": "37ae055ff667b7eca53110676856524708f5226dddf7247155c106065a58f29d", "project_identity": "local:dee89d9b00c29f8b46038582d3569cd8157162fec6f171d84685bc8b23f83a09", "line_start": 129, "line_end": 164, "authority": "source_of_truth", "scope": "project", "source_uri": "docatlas://source/e58eafb08d9e75d8f9bef5a4"}, {"evidence_id": "ev-623985bb7e7c2f60", "path_or_url": "docs/concepts/alias.md", "section": "Introduction", "snippet": "An alias is an alternative name for a field, used when serializing and deserializing data.", "version_binding": "unversioned", "content_sha256": "7055b7b5e3c28df2f7e5ed1fea0d237ada5affee4c2bb534c8cceb7b83b6c3ea", "project_identity": "local:dee89d9b00c29f8b46038582d3569cd8157162fec6f171d84685bc8b23f83a09", "line_start": 1, "line_end": 1, "authority": "source_of_truth", "scope": "project", "source_uri": "docatlas://source/7c6e969136d11068fc98cdc9"}], "context_quality": {"status": "partial", "reasons": ["requested_part_missing"]}, "read_next": [], "edit_ready": false, "investigation_allowed": true, "estimated_tokens": 694}
